timestamp_note: Whisper segment timestamps are estimates; verify against the video before editing.
score_note: Hybrid ranking: football event phrase matching plus a trained match-half sequence model (weak SoccerNet event timestamps plus manually reviewed examples); not a calibrated probability or a direct measure of highlight quality.

pipeline_stages.speech_to_text: pretrained Faster-Whisper; language auto-detection or user override
pipeline_stages.translation: optional pretrained NLLB translation to English; timestamps retained
pipeline_stages.nlp_preprocessing: project-written text normalization, lexical event evidence, and negation/hypothetical/retrospective/live-action cues
pipeline_stages.coreference: conservative short-window pronoun linking only when a unique verified player alias is present; otherwise unresolved
pipeline_stages.event_extraction: project-written event rules plus lexical event frames; actor/team arguments are candidates, not full SRL predictions
pipeline_stages.text_representation: project-fitted TF-IDF unigram/bigram features when TF-IDF checkpoint is selected; otherwise hashed word features
pipeline_stages.deep_learning: project-trained BiGRU with temporal self-attention and eventness/event-family heads; exploratory weak supervision
pipeline_stages.temporal_selection: score-based nearby-event grouping with a reported peak timestamp and density
pipeline_stages.explainability: TF-IDF feature ablation when available; this is not an attention map
limitations: Coreference and event-role extraction use conservative dictionary/phrase heuristics, not trained coreference or SRL models
Only fixture team names are auto-read from SoccerNet-style paths; player names require a verified aliases JSON
No human excitement labels in current training data
Event-family head, when present, is weak-label trained and performed poorly on rare classes in match-held-out review
No claim of universal accuracy across languages or competitions
